subject: Vendor onboarding: PO conditional acceptance and multi-entity VAT proof
messages:
From: Anna Lee <procurement@vertexhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO acceptance criteria for multi-entity invoices

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to begin vendor registration for Redwood but need to confirm a couple of billing rules so our AP can accept invoices without manual splits. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support the following requirements?

1) PO number in the invoice header (exact PO string).
2) Invoice must include the legal entity/GL code that matches the PO line (we have 3 legal entities in scope for this program).
3) VAT/Tax ID evidence per legal entity (EU VAT certificate or local tax registration).
4) Bank details and remit-to must match the profile we upload to Coupa (SEPA IBAN or ACH).
5) We require a signed supplier onboarding packet (standard terms) + completed AP import template.

Please attach the vendor packet and a table of Redwood legal entities + VAT IDs so we can validate mapping and start the Coupa enrollment. Ideally we can complete registration and a test invoice by end of next week.

I've attached our AP_Import_Template.xlsx (column guidance included). If Redwood cannot present separate invoices per legal entity, tell us how you recommend we handle consolidated billing so PO matching still works.

Regards,
Anna Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Vertex Health
Attachment: AP_Import_Template.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <procurement@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO acceptance criteria for multi-entity invoices

Hi Anna — thanks, and great to get this detail.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support the PO/header requirement and provide separate invoices per legal entity; we can also support a consolidated invoice workflow if the PO includes the sub-entity code on the PO header (we recommend per-entity invoices for fastest AP automation).

What I'm attaching: our Redwood_Vendor_Registry_Packet.pdf (signed supplier onboarding + W-9/W-8 template options) and Redwood_VAT_table.csv with the legal entity names, registered VAT IDs, and remit details.

Implementation notes / ask from your team:
- For Coupa enrollment, please assign the vendor code to one of our legal entities and list the additional entities in the vendor profile "related entities" field.
- If Vertex requires a single supplier ID for all invoices, we will include the PO line-level metadata (GL code) in the invoice line description and add a header field "Redwood Legal Entity"; however this requires a small mapping change on your side to map PO GL -> remit routing.
- Can you share a sample PO (PDF or XML) so our billing team can validate matching rules?

Proposed timeline: we will submit the registry packet today and can upload bank/VAT evidence within 24 hours. If Vertex can push the Coupa invite, we can accept and validate a test invoice within 3 business days.

Thanks — I'll follow up with Ben (billing) and Marissa (finance ops) to action items.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0184
Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Registry_Packet.pdf; Redwood_VAT_table.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO acceptance criteria for multi-entity invoices

Dylan / Marissa — internal checklist for Coupa/Ariba enrollment and invoice routing: 

- Action 1: Upload Redwood_Vendor_Registry_Packet.pdf to Vertex portal once invite received. Ensure vendor legal names match our GLs (Redwood US Inc., Redwood EU SARL, Redwood UK Ltd).
- Action 2: Populate Redwood_VAT_table.csv into the "Tax IDs" section for each legal entity record. Vertex requires VAT certificate scans for EU entities; Marissa, please pull the latest certs from Vault.
- Action 3: Billing system mapping: add header field "Supplier Entity ID" that equals our legal entity short code (RWI-US / RWI-EU / RWI-UK). Their PO processor must pass that through to AP matching. If they can't, invoices must be split per entity.
- Action 4: Test invoice: Prepare a split test invoice and a consolidated test invoice (with line-level entity codes) so Vertex can choose which matching path to enable.

Marissa — can you assemble the three test invoices (one per entity) and one consolidated (single invoice with entity codes in lines)? Target EOD Thursday so we can push to procurement Friday.

Ben
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Lee <procurement@vertexhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO acceptance criteria for multi-entity invoices

Thanks Dylan — received your packet and the VAT table looks clean. Couple quick updates: 

- We've issued a supplier portal invite to Redwood (vendor code VXH-5492). Please use the link to complete registration and upload the signed packet and VAT certs: https://vendor.vertexhealth.com/invite/VXH-5492
- Our AP team needs the Supplier Entity ID field populated exactly as follows in invoices: "SupplierEntityID" (case sensitive).
- We will accept consolidated invoices only if line-level SupplierEntityID is present for every line item. Otherwise please submit separate invoices for each legal entity.
- Attached is the portal invitation and a DocuSign envelope for tax forms (if applicable). Please complete the DocuSign by end of next Tuesday.

Next steps: once you accept the invite and upload documents, we'll provision the vendor in Coupa (VXH-5492) and send a confirmation once the test invoice passes. I'll schedule a 30 min onboarding call for Wednesday 9:00am CET — please confirm availability.

Anna Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Vertex Health
Attachment: Supplier_Portal_Invitation.html
